lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill region. Vertical columns consist of 3 to 5 visible centroids per column across the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the large white blobs to form a regular matrix of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, showing a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the dorsal side of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of significantly smaller, irregularly distributed high-luminance points located anterior to the first gill slit on the cranial/neck region.
